description: The Gujarat government has established the Indian AI Research Organization (IAIRO) to foster AI research and development at the newly inaugurated AI Centre of Excellence in GIFT City, promoting innovation in artificial intelligence through a unique public-private partnership.
body_lead: Gujarat forms IAIRO SPV to run AI Centre of Excellence at GIFT City New entity to operate as non-profit with 11:89 govt–private equity split; state to fund 33% of R&D cost under tripartite pact with Centre and industry partners. The Gujarat govt formed a special purpose vehicle, the Indian AI Research Organization (IAIRO), to drive research and development activities at the AI Centre of Excellence (AI CoE), which was inaugurated last Jan at GIFT City in Gandhinagar.
